# netbox_aggregate (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/ipam/#aggregates):

> NetBox allows us to specify the portions of IP space that are interesting to us by defining aggregates. Typically, an aggregate will correspond to either an allocation of public (globally routable) IP space granted by a regional authority, or a private (internally-routable) designation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_rir" "test" {
  name = "testrir"
}
resource "netbox_aggregate" "test" {
  prefix      = "1.1.1.0/25"
  description = "my description"
  rir_id      = netbox_rir.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `prefix` (String) The prefix in CIDR notation.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the aggregate.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `date_added` (String) The date added of the aggregate.
- `description` (String) A description of the aggregate.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the aggregate. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `rir_id` (Number) The ID of the rir associated with the aggregate.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the aggregate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_aggregate.example 1
```
